items.name: Curious alien visitor
items.description: A green alien with a pear-shaped oversized head, long antennae and a compact plum jumpsuit.

items.name: Optimistic astronaut
items.description: An astronaut in a cream spacesuit with a large round blue-edged clear helmet, chest panel and ochre gloves.

items.name: Friendly barista
items.description: A barista with short curls, coral shirt and a dark green apron with a large cream coffee cup emblem.

items.name: Gentle lumbering bear
items.description: A broad brown bear with small round ears, a cream muzzle and a large soft belly; a gentle giant.

items.name: Sardonic house cat
items.description: A slate-blue cat with triangular ears, long curling tail and a cream chest; poised to judge everyone.

items.name: Busy chef
items.description: A stout chef with a tall cloud-shaped white toque, double-breasted coat, red neckerchief and rolled sleeves.

items.name: Resourceful builder
items.description: A construction worker with an ochre hard hat, reflective orange vest and sturdy dark trousers.

items.name: Suspicious detective
items.description: A detective with a tilted brown fedora and oversized ochre trench-coat lapels; useful for mysteries and interrogation.

items.name: Thoughtful doctor
items.description: A dark-skinned doctor in a sea-green coat, short curls, and a clearly visible stethoscope; useful for clinics and absurd diagnoses.

items.name: Loyal scruffy dog
items.description: A sandy upright dog with one floppy dark ear, a cream muzzle, jaunty tail and a red collar.

items.name: Small dramatic dragon
items.description: A coral dragon with gold horns, small angular wings, a sweeping tail and a pale armored belly.

items.name: Steady farmer
items.description: A broad-shouldered farmer in a straw hat and green overalls with a cream work shirt.

items.name: Resolute firefighter
items.description: A firefighter in an ochre helmet and red turnout coat with bright reflective bands; broad stance and reassuring expression.

items.name: Smooth-talking fox
items.description: An orange fox with enormous pointed ears, angular cream cheeks and a sweeping white-tipped tail.

items.name: Confident pond frog
items.description: A green frog with wide-set raised eyes, a pale throat and very long splayed orange toes.

items.name: Polite sheet ghost
items.description: A floating cream ghost with a scalloped trailing sheet and expressive dark eyes; friendly rather than frightening.

items.name: Stubborn goat
items.description: A cream goat with swept-back horns, angular ears, a pointed chin beard and dark split hooves.

items.name: Dapper grandfather
items.description: An elderly man with wispy silver side hair, a plum waistcoat, bow tie and small gold reading spectacles.

items.name: Spirited grandmother
items.description: An elderly woman with a silver hair bun, green dress and bold coral scarf; an energetic family matriarch.

items.name: Stern judge
items.description: A silver-haired judge with a wide black robe, cream neck tabs and a deliberately unimpressed brow.

items.name: Exacting librarian
items.description: A librarian with a high dark bun, half-moon spectacles, plum cardigan and an orderly stack of books.

items.name: Cheerful mail carrier
items.description: A postal worker in a blue cap and uniform with a diagonal satchel strap and a cream envelope.

items.name: Practical mechanic
items.description: A mechanic with a red cap, blue overalls, rolled sleeves and a chunky wrench tucked into the bib pocket.

items.name: Plucky little mouse
items.description: A tiny upright grey mouse with enormous pink-lined ears, thin tail and a red neckerchief.

items.name: Cool jazz musician
items.description: A musician with swept-up hair, plum suit, mustard scarf and a stylized brass trumpet held across the torso.

items.name: Overworked office worker
items.description: A brown-skinned office worker with an untidy side part, rolled teal sleeves and a loosened red tie.

items.name: Scholarly owl
items.description: A round ochre owl with dramatic cream facial discs, plum wings and small orange talons.

items.name: Formal penguin
items.description: A black-and-cream penguin with flipper arms, ochre feet and a small red bow tie.

items.name: Swaggering pirate
items.description: A pirate captain with an asymmetric black tricorn, red coat and cream cravat; both eyes remain expressive for animation.

items.name: Anxious rabbit
items.description: A cream rabbit with one bent long ear, oversized hind feet, coral waistcoat and a tiny pink nose.

items.name: Resourceful raccoon
items.description: A grey raccoon with a dark face mask and a large striped tail; nimble paws suit secretive schemes.

items.name: Helpful box robot
items.description: A teal-and-cream service robot with a square head, asymmetrical antenna, segmented limbs and a gold chest dial.

items.name: Pompous monarch
items.description: A monarch with a large three-point crown, plum robe, cream collar and an oversized gold medallion.

items.name: Excitable scientist
items.description: An older scientist with white hair flaring sideways, teal shirt and a white laboratory coat with a pen pocket.

items.name: Curious student
items.description: A young student with a rounded hair bob, coral hoodie, and bright mustard backpack straps.

items.name: Earnest superhero
items.description: A superhero in a teal suit with a dramatic coral cape, ochre belt and a bold lightning chest emblem.

items.name: Patient teacher
items.description: A warm brown-skinned teacher with a high hair bun, mustard cardigan and an open green lesson book; calm schoolroom authority.

items.name: Delighted tourist
items.description: A tourist with a floppy sun hat, coral vacation shirt and a large camera hanging over the chest.

items.name: Self-important unicorn
items.description: A cream unicorn with a long gold horn, flowing coral mane, tiny hooves and a flamboyant tail.

items.name: Distracted wizard
items.description: A wizard wearing a tall bent plum hat and robe, with a flowing silver beard framing a visible animated mouth.

items.name: Airport departure lounge
items.description: Broad terminal windows overlooking a parked plane silhouette, overhead gate sign and seating.

items.name: Alien planet surface
items.description: Otherworldly mushroom plants frame a spacious dusty landscape beneath two moons.

items.name: Inside a city bus
items.description: A symmetrical aisle with paired seats, broad windows and yellow grab rails.

items.name: Castle great hall
items.description: Stone columns, hanging banners and an arched doorway surrounding a ceremonial carpet.

items.name: Public library
items.description: Book-filled shelves flank a quiet reading table and tall window.

items.name: Neighborhood street
items.description: A walkable city block with warm shopfronts and a streetlamp along the sidewalk.

items.name: School classroom
items.description: Green chalkboard, geometric lesson and teacher desk with open floor for classroom scenes.

items.name: Office conference room
items.description: Presentation screen and boardroom table in a calm modern office. Clear foreground for meetings, interviews and corporate comedy.

items.name: Courtroom
items.description: Wooden judges bench under a scales emblem, with an open hearing floor.

items.name: Cozy living room
items.description: Warm lounge with red sofa, framed landscape and large window; clear space in front for actors.

items.name: Elevator lobby
items.description: Closed elevator doors with call buttons and a potted plant in a spare building lobby.

items.name: Red barn farmyard
items.description: A red barn with cross-braced doors, fence sections and rolling fields.

items.name: Fire station garage
items.description: Red segmented engine bay door, brass pole and equipment locker; no vehicle embedded.

items.name: Forest clearing
items.description: Layered evergreen trees frame a sunlit woodland path and open clearing.

items.name: Neighborhood grocery store
items.description: Two stocked shelving units and a produce display around a clear shopping aisle.

items.name: Home kitchen
items.description: Domestic kitchen with cupboards, window, sink and an open floor for family or cooking scenes.

items.name: Hospital waiting room
items.description: Quiet medical waiting area with paired benches, clock and marked treatment door.

items.name: Research laboratory
items.description: A clean laboratory with glass flasks, a workbench and overhead pipework.

items.name: Limestone cave
items.description: Deep rock chamber framed by stalactites and a shallow turquoise pool.

items.name: Mountain overlook
items.description: Snow-capped peaks behind a broad rocky overlook with space for hikers or adventurers.

items.name: Police station reception
items.description: Reception desk, investigation noticeboard and shield emblem for police procedural scenes.

items.name: Restaurant dining room
items.description: An intimate restaurant with draped window, pendant light and small side tables.

items.name: City rooftop at night
items.description: Moonlit skyline behind a rooftop parapet and a small stairwell entrance.

items.name: Rustic tavern
items.description: Timber-beamed inn with bottle shelves, oak barrel and a substantial wooden bar.

items.name: Sunny seaside beach
items.description: Gentle waves, a striped beach umbrella and a wide open stretch of sand.

items.name: Spaceship bridge
items.description: Angular observation windows, ring-lit planet and broad control console on a spacecraft bridge.

items.name: Theater stage
items.description: Red velvet curtains and a warm pool of stage light on wooden boards.

items.name: Covered train platform
items.description: A station canopy, clock, waiting train and layered rails for travel scenes.

items.name: Underwater reef
items.description: Sunbeams, seaweed and branching coral surround an open sandy seabed.

items.name: Woodland campsite at dusk
items.description: Canvas tent and evergreen silhouettes under moonlight, with open campsite foreground.

items.name: Everyday backpack
items.description: A slouchy blue backpack with a cream front pocket, red zipper pulls and an arched carrying loop.

items.name: Perfectly suspicious banana
items.description: A sweeping yellow banana with a curled tip, green stem and broad inner ridge. A simple readable comedy or kitchen prop.

items.name: Well-loved hardback
items.description: A chunky red hardback book with a cloth spine, cream page block and a gold bookmark peeking below.

items.name: Straw broom
items.description: A wide bristled straw broom with a tall red handle, teal binding and an uneven working edge.

items.name: Celebration cake
items.description: A two-layer strawberry cake with dripping cream icing, three candles and a broad serving plate.

items.name: Wooden kitchen chair
items.description: A warm wooden chair in three-quarter view with a teal cushion, open back slats and four clearly separated legs.

items.name: Inspection clipboard
items.description: A honey-colored clipboard with an oversized metal clip and three bold checklist ticks. Useful for officials, doctors and very serious inspections.

items.name: Alarm clock
items.description: A cream twin-bell alarm clock with red bells, clearly visible dark hands and a teal round face.

items.name: Slightly crooked crown
items.description: A theatrical gold crown with five broad points, a red central gem and a deep teal inset band.

items.name: Fire extinguisher
items.description: A red fire extinguisher with a black hose, pressure gauge and a bold flame symbol on its cream label.

items.name: Yellow inspection flashlight
items.description: A sturdy yellow flashlight with an oversized blue lens, rubber grip and hanging wrist loop.

items.name: Big ribbon gift
items.description: A coral present with a wide cream ribbon and exuberant asymmetrical bow, suitable for birthdays or suspicious deliveries.

items.name: Carpenter hammer
items.description: A heavy steel claw hammer with a long amber handle and a red grip. The split claw and flat striking head read clearly.

items.name: Caretaker keyring
items.description: A large blue keyring holding two distinct metal keys and a coral identification tag. Useful for doors, hotels, caretakers and a missing-key reveal.

items.name: Stickered laptop
items.description: An open teal laptop with a bright blank screen, chunky keyboard and a little lightning sticker. The screen is clear enough for a scene overlay.

items.name: Red rally megaphone
items.description: A bright red cone megaphone with a cream horn rim, hand grip and a visible talk button.

items.name: Stand microphone
items.description: A silver vintage stage microphone on a tall dark stand, with a red on-air switch and broad stable foot.

items.name: Mop and bucket
items.description: A coral cleaning bucket with a looping handle and a leaning mop whose broad cream strands hang over the rim.

items.name: Folded newspaper
items.description: A broad folded cream newspaper with a dramatic headline block, a framed photo and clean column shapes. No real publication or story is named.

items.name: Pizza on a tray
items.description: A generous round pizza on a dark serving tray, with six red pepperoni rounds, basil leaves and one slightly shifted slice.

items.name: Resilient houseplant
items.description: A cheerful broad-leaf houseplant with an asymmetrical branching silhouette and a terracotta pot. Leaves have generous gaps for clear stage readability.

items.name: Lunch sandwich
items.description: A tall triangular sandwich showing crisp lettuce, tomato and cheese between two generous slices of bread.

items.name: Blank sandwich-board sign
items.description: A freestanding chalkboard sandwich sign with a warm wood frame and a deliberately empty dark writing surface. Add scene-specific text over the board.

items.name: Travel suitcase
items.description: An upright mustard rolling suitcase with an extended handle, two wheels and bold contrasting travel labels.

items.name: Round cafe table
items.description: A compact round cafe table with a honey-colored top and a dark branching pedestal, leaving room for actors on both sides.

items.name: Traffic cone
items.description: A sturdy orange road cone with two broad cream reflective stripes and a wide dark weighted base.

items.name: Pirate treasure chest
items.description: An open wooden treasure chest with an arched lid, brass bands and a mound of oversized gold coins.

items.name: First-place trophy
items.description: A large gold cup with proud curling handles, a narrow stem and a solid teal prize plinth.

items.name: Storm umbrella
items.description: An open teal umbrella with alternating cream panels, a curved wooden handle and scalloped rain canopy.

items.name: Workshop wrench
items.description: A broad steel open-end wrench with a blue handle inset and unmistakable crescent jaw.
